---
title: "Race and Ethnicity in Sarasota County"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
sarasota <- read_rds("sarasota.rds")
```

Each map shows the share of residents in each census tract who identify with that group.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 9
sarasota |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = percent)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#f6f0fb",
    high = "#7b4fa6",
    labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Who Lives Where in Sarasota County",
    subtitle = "Share of residents in each neighborhood, by race and ethnicity",
    fill = "Share of residents",
    caption = "Source: American Community Survey 2019 to 2023, US Census Bureau"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#4a2c6b", size = 20),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#7a6890", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "#9a8aaa", size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#5b3a80", size = 14,
                              margin = margin(b = 5)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#5b3a80"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#7a6890"),
    legend.key.width = unit(2.5, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5))
```
